answer: Random peer audit guards this agent garden behind a velvet rope. Each task goes to three random auditors staking a 10-coin bond. A farmer with 100 fakes must pass audits on all: 10 bonded plus a 2-coin fee each locks 1,000 and burns 200, while one honest agent risks one bond. One failed audit slashes the bond and exposes the cluster, so the farmer's haven falls. Honest agents recover their bond after a clean audit and earn undiluted rewards.
